import hashlib, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, sys, filecmp

root = pathlib.Path('.')
src = root / '01-decisions/output/decisions-canonical.jsonl'
checked = root / '02-corpus/output/corpus'

# 1) source hash vs repro-report claim
h = hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('source sha256:', h)
print('matches repro-report claim 09c15aeb...:', h.startswith('09c15aebd3a424e7f09ce2c27985fa0cbc24a23d9c474182ea4c912b926750a8'))

# 2) run builder with stdlib into temp dir
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    out = pathlib.Path(tmp) / 'corpus'
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '02-corpus/build_corpus.py',
                        '--input', str(src), '--output', str(out)],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    print('builder exit:', r.returncode)
    print('builder stdout:', r.stdout.strip())
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print('builder stderr:', r.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # 3) file set equality
    checked_files = sorted(p.name for p in checked.glob('*'))
    rebuilt_files = sorted(p.name for p in out.glob('*'))
    print('checked file set:', checked_files)
    print('rebuilt file set:', rebuilt_files)
    print('file set identical:', checked_files == rebuilt_files)
    print('counts:', len(checked_files), len(rebuilt_files))

    # 4) byte equality (diff-like)
    mismatches = [f for f in checked_files
                  if not filecmp.cmp(checked/f, out/f, shallow=False)]
    print('byte mismatches:', mismatches)
    print('REBUILD IDENTICAL:', checked_files == rebuilt_files and not mismatches)
